letter_deductions.deduction: Less: Room / ICU rent above eligible limit
Less: Crepe bandage - List I (not payable)
Less: Documentation charges - List II (part of room charges)
Less: Proportionate deduction (room category above eligibility)
letter_deductions.why: Insurer cut 1/3 of 60,350 (= 20,116.67, rounded 20,117), which includes medicines 6,850; cl. 4.1 Note 2 exempts cost of medicines -> 1/3 of 53,500.
5% of admissible (cl. 9.3); differs because of the proportionate cut.

notes: Ambulance: the wording caps road ambulance at 2,000 per hospitalisation (cl. 4.1.1(v)) although List I item 67 says 'Ambulance'; the specific cover clause is read as overriding List I. Ambulance is treated as outside the Note 2 proportionate cut (transport, not a charge that varies with room category); if it were included, 2,000 x (1 - 2/3) = 667 more would be cut. Insurer's 20,117 is 60,350/3 rounded. Underpaid by 2,170.
